mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies and a comfortable 79 degrees while you enjoy the Military Ridge State Trail, with a stunning full moon expected tonight.

The City of Verona is celebrating September as National Senior Center Month, highlighting the great work of our local center which offers everything from tri-shaw bike rides to nutritious meal delivery and diverse exercise classes.

There is so much happening today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, our downtown farmers market, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow or visit the kids triathlon this Saturday.

In our weekly update, police reported that on August 17, they located and arrested a 21-year-old man on Cross Country Road following a request from the Department of Corrections regarding a probation violation.
Today's flavor is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, so head over to enjoy your treat before they close at 10 PM.
